memory_candidates: A FrameOver-valued def whose body is a known constructor (ofSlicedStep) lets its companion lemmas be cited verbatim with `exact <companion> _ _ _`: the carrier projections (w.2, (z,q), p q : Z x Q) unify definitionally through the def with no show/change, so a whole 'build the model' phase can be seven one-line citations rather than re-proved field discharges.

A valuation that must agree with a closure-indexed labelling is cleanest as an existential over the membership PROOF (`exists h : atom p in closure, lab w.2 (clLetter phi h) = true`): Finset membership is a Prop, so proofs are definitionally equal and clLetter phi h' IS clLetter phi h -- the rewrite lemma is then the anonymous constructor with no transport, where a dite needs DecidablePred plumbing and a dif_pos at every use.

In this repo a .lean-touching phase commit is refused by the typst-sync-check.sh Check 2 pre-commit gate on formalsystem-line-count drift; the standing remedy is `bash scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix` plus adding typst/generated/status.typ to the phase commit's explicit path list. --fix and --counts-only are not composable.
